name: provider-named-like-in-process-reader-refused
description: A repository configuration whose provider entry takes the name deadset-proto, the name of the schema reader inside deadset. The run is refused naming the entry's name, because every file a run writes for an analyzer is keyed by its name and the reader's files already carry that one.
pending: the Protocol Buffers schema reader inside deadset, which reads the .proto files and joins the analyzers' binding facts; no deadset release carries it yet.
